original_test_intent: Verify the system remains stable and truly idle for 24 hours at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without hangs, unexpected wake/sleep transitions, platform errors or loss of management visibility.
original_method: Define idle utilization/power/background-task bounds and approved hibernate/sleep changes with rollback; preserve baseline logs; control humidity/dew point, cold-soak and measured +5% rails; maintain the system untouched for 24 hours while recording heartbeat, power states, utilization, clocks, sensors, BMC reachability and events at an approved cadence; abort on limits, warm safely and restore original power settings and nominal environment.
manual_activity: Operator establishes dry cold/high-rail conditions, monitors the unattended soak and safely warms/restores power settings.
required_inputs: Idle utilization/power and allowed background-task bounds
Approved hibernate/sleep setting changes and rollback
Expected low-power/C-state behavior and event allowlist
safety_requirements: Avoid unapproved sleep or hibernate transitions that hide uptime
Abort on lost heartbeat, moisture, electrical, thermal or severe event fault
Warm above dew point and restore original settings
agent_execution_scope: Must not control chamber/rails or change platform power policy and must not decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve idle definition, settings and monitoring cadence
Supervise unattended soak and abort path

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct manual boundary; elapsed time alone does not prove true idle or continuous health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator applies only approved power settings and records the 24-hour idle state with independent heartbeat under stable cold/high-rail conditions.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate continuous reachability and idle/power-state telemetry with chamber, dew-point and rail data for the entire 24 hours.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds measurable idle bounds, settings rollback, heartbeat, condensation controls and safe warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A responsive endpoint at hour 24 does not prove continuous idle stability or absence of unintended sleep/wake events.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Background services can invalidate idle coverage, while disabled hibernate without recorded original state can alter the platform after the test.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines idle thresholds, acceptable power-state residency, monitoring traffic that does not invalidate idle and power-policy rollback.
expected_evidence: 24-hour heartbeat, power-state, utilization and sensor timeline
Settings rollback, safe warm-up and nominal post-health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests a 24-hour idle cold/high-rail soak; idle thresholds and expected power behavior are missing inputs, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose and duration are clear; safe manual execution needs idle definition, monitoring and environmental controls.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row48 Wistron-Margin-00047-V003: define idle utilization/power/background-task bounds, approve sleep/hibernate changes and rollback, 24-hour heartbeat/telemetry cadence, 0C humidity/dew-point/+5% rail limits, expected power-state behavior, event/abort policy, safe warm-up and restoration.

review_improvement: Turns an unattended elapsed-time soak into measurable continuous idle stability with reversible power-policy and cold-safety controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Idle-margin failures may occur during low-power state entry/exit or after long periods of reduced activity. Without state residency and heartbeat evidence, a system that slept, rebooted or became unreachable could still appear healthy at final inspection.
